visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a black t-shirt and glasses enters a dimly lit apartment corridor, carrying grocery bags filled with green onions and other brown-paper-wrapped items. The hallway is narrow with plain white walls and a dark wooden door. Lighting is low-intensity, casting heavy blue-toned shadows. (2) He stops to look at a wall-mounted digital security tablet which has a small glowing red indicator light. A single white candle flickers on a white side table nearby. The camera uses a handheld motion, creating a sense of tension as he glances around cautiously. (3) The man sits on a sofa with a black and white zebra-patterned throw. He interacts with a black smartphone, scrolling through a digital app interface. He picks up a clear glass of water and drinks while staring intently at the phone screen. (4) A series of rapid cuts shows various grocery items including eggs, bread, and fruits laid out on a table next to Uber Eats bags. Detailed text overlays with price tags appear. The man is then shown washing his face in a modern bathroom with grey tiles. (5) He looks into a bathroom mirror and reacts with an extremely exaggerated shocked expression, mouth wide open and hands raised. He is then shown in a bright supermarket aisle, holding a green and red apple and smiling cheerfully toward the camera. (6) He points energetically at the camera while large white text overlays appear on screen. The scene alternates between the dark bathroom and the brightly lit supermarket shelves. He uses wide hand gestures to emphasize points while maintaining high facial energy. (7) The video concludes with a close-up of his face as he smiles comically while another partial figure whispers in his ear. A digital green shopping bag icon appears. The final frame shows a static graphic of a cartoon character and social media handles.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous horror-inspired setup to reveal the 'shockingly low' prices of groceries on Uber Eats. It aims to drive app downloads and usage by highlighting that in-store prices are available for delivery and offering a 9th-anniversary discount code.
